Bir Billing Escape: Paragliding, Rajgundha Valley & Prashar Lake

Delhi — Bir — Billing — Rajgundha Valley — Hanumangarh — Prashar Lake — Mandi — Delhi

About This Trip

Trade the routine for high-altitude adrenaline and high-mountain peace on this 3-day Himalayan getaway. Your adventure kicks off at Billing—the world’s second-highest paragliding site—where you'll launch into the air for a breath-taking aerial flight over the Dhauladhar ranges. Back on the ground, immerse yourself in Bir’s vibrant culture with warm bonfires, cozy Tibetan cafés, and front-row seats to the valley's legendary sunsets at the landing site. From there, we leave the usual tourist trail behind to venture into Rajgundha Valley, an untouched village surrounded by terraced fields, dense oak forests, and star-lit night skies. The trip rounds off at the mystical Prashar Lake, sitting at 2,730 meters alongside its 14th-century pagoda-style temple and a mysterious floating island. It’s the ultimate blend of thrill, culture, and quiet alpine magic packed into a single weekend.
